valor: As the First World War drags on, Pierre, a young Belgian soldier newly arrived at the front, wants to prove himself. Behind the lines he meets Francis, who puts on shows to lift the troops' spirits. Amid the violence, both look for ways to escape the brutality of war, if only for a moment.
motivo: El inglés perdía la idea central (los espectáculos) y contradecía al español: 'is asked' frente a 'decide'.
